analysis.application_type: Vault / SOL Custody (with fee-sharing on withdrawal)
analysis.description: A minimal Anchor program that lets any user create a personal program-derived vault to custody SOL. Anyone may deposit into an existing vault, but only its recorded authority may withdraw, optionally routing a fixed 1% fee to a caller-supplied fee-collector account while the rest goes to the authority.

components.name: System Program
components.description: The standard Solana System Program. Invoked via CPI during `deposit` to transfer lamports from the depositor into the vault PDA, and implicitly by Anchor's `init` constraint during `initialize` to allocate/fund the new vault account.
assumptions: Correctly executes lamport transfers and account creation as instructed.
Enforces that the depositor/payer has sufficient lamports and has signed the transaction.

components.name: Vault Authority
components.description: The end-user keypair recorded as `vault.authority` when a vault is initialized. It is the sole party permitted to withdraw from its vault and must sign every withdrawal.
assumptions: Is the legitimate owner of the vault; the program only checks that the signing account matches the PDA's recorded authority (via `has_one`/seeds), not any off-chain notion of ownership.
May act as depositor or payer for other vaults as well, since deposits are unrestricted.

components.name: Fee Collector
components.description: An optional, caller-supplied account passed to `withdraw` to receive a 1% (100 bps) fee share of the withdrawal amount.
assumptions: Is untrusted and unchecked by the program beyond being a valid account able to receive lamports — it is only ever credited, never debited or read, so no ownership or type constraint is enforced on it.
Its presence or absence is entirely at the withdrawing authority's discretion for a given call.

components.name: Vault
components.description: Implements a per-user SOL vault. Each user has exactly one vault PDA (seeds `["vault", authority]`) tracking an `authority` and a `balance`. Deposits are open to anyone; withdrawals are restricted to the recorded authority and optionally split off a 1% fee to a supplied fee collector.

instructions.name: initialize
instructions.description: Creates and initializes the caller's vault PDA, recording the caller as authority with a zero balance.

accounts.name: vault
constraints: init — must not already exist; enforces exactly one vault per authority

cpis.description: Implicit CPI performed by Anchor's `init` constraint to allocate and fund the new vault account, paid for by `authority`.

requirements: The instruction must derive `vault` as the canonical PDA of ["vault", authority.key()].
The instruction must fail if a vault for this authority already exists.
A given authority must have exactly one vault.
The instruction must set vault.authority = authority.key(), vault.balance = 0, and store the derivation bump.

instructions.name: deposit
instructions.description: Transfers `amount` lamports from the depositor into the vault PDA and increases the vault's recorded balance by the same amount.

accounts.name: vault
constraints: seeds = ["vault", vault.authority.as_ref()], bump = vault.bump — validates the account is the canonical vault for its stored authority

accounts.name: depositor
constraints: must hold at least `amount` lamports (enforced by the System Program transfer)

cpis.description: Directly invokes a `system_instruction::transfer` moving `amount` lamports from depositor to vault (no PDA signer needed since depositor signs).

requirements: The instruction must transfer exactly `amount` lamports from the depositor to the vault via the System Program.
The instruction must increase vault.balance by amount, failing on arithmetic overflow.
Anyone may deposit into any existing vault; the depositor need not be the vault's authority.

instructions.name: withdraw
instructions.description: Moves `amount` lamports out of the vault, decreasing the recorded balance, and pays the authority (and optionally a fee collector) directly by lamport transfer. If a fee collector is supplied, 1% (100 bps) of `amount` goes to it and the remainder to the authority; otherwise the authority receives the full amount.

accounts.name: vault
constraints: has_one = authority — vault.authority must equal the supplied authority account

accounts.name: authority
constraints: must equal vault.authority (enforced via has_one on vault)

accounts.name: fee_collector
constraints: none enforced — explicitly unchecked, since it is only ever credited lamports and never debited or read

requirements: The instruction must fail if amount exceeds vault.balance (insufficient funds).
The instruction must decrease vault.balance by exactly amount, failing on underflow/overflow (checked arithmetic).
The instruction must debit exactly amount lamports from the vault account directly (no CPI, via direct lamport mutation since the vault is owned by this program).
When fee_collector is supplied, the instruction must credit it with amount * 100 / 10_000 (1%) lamports and credit the authority with the remainder.
When fee_collector is not supplied, the instruction must credit the authority with the full amount.
The instruction must conserve lamports: the sum credited to the authority and (if present) the fee collector must equal the amount debited from the vault.
Supplying a fee collector must never cause the authority to receive more than it would have received without one.
Only the account recorded as vault.authority, and only when it signs, may withdraw from that vault.

account_types: VaultState — PDA at seeds ["vault", authority]; stores `authority: Pubkey` (the owner/withdrawer), `balance: u64` (net lamports recorded as deposited minus withdrawn), and `bump: u8` (the PDA derivation bump). Exactly one is created per authority.

components.name: Vault Lifecycle & Initialization
components.description: Establishes the one-vault-per-authority invariant by creating and seeding the canonical vault PDA for a new user.

interactions.description: The caller signs and pays to create its own vault, becoming the vault's recorded authority.
Relied upon, via Anchor's `init` constraint, to create and fund the new vault account.

requirements: The implementation must enforce exactly one vault per authority via PDA derivation combined with the `init` constraint.
The implementation must never allow re-initialization of an existing vault.
The implementation must ensure the vault PDA is always the canonical PDA of ["vault", authority] for its recorded authority.

components.name: Deposits
components.description: Allows any party to add lamports to an existing vault, keeping the vault's recorded balance in lockstep with the lamports actually held by the PDA.

interactions.description: Invoked via CPI to perform the lamport transfer from the depositor to the vault.
Operates on the VaultState PDA created by `initialize`; requires the vault to already exist.

requirements: The implementation must move lamports through an explicit System Program transfer rather than a raw lamport mutation.
The implementation must keep balance accounting overflow-safe and consistent with the amount actually transferred.

components.name: Withdrawals & Fee Sharing
components.description: Lets a vault's authority withdraw previously-deposited lamports, with an optional mechanism to divert a fixed 1% fee to a caller-supplied fee collector while conserving total lamports moved.

interactions.description: Must sign the withdrawal and match vault.authority (enforced via has_one); receives the non-fee portion of the withdrawal.
Optional, untrusted account credited the 1% fee share when supplied by the authority.
Operates on the VaultState PDA created by `initialize`; requires the vault to already exist and hold sufficient recorded balance.

requirements: The implementation must restrict withdrawal to the signing, recorded authority only.
The implementation must never withdraw more than the vault's recorded balance.
The implementation must conserve lamports across the authority/fee-collector split (amount leaving the vault equals amount received by authority plus fee collector).
The implementation must ensure supplying a fee collector never increases the amount the authority receives relative to omitting one.

Deposits.description: If `deposit(amount)` succeeds, the vault's recorded `balance` after the call equals its balance before the call plus `amount` computed over exact integers — no double credit, truncation, or wrap — so the recorded balance never diverges from the lamports actually moved.
Deposits.title: deposit_credits_exactly_amount

Deposits.description: If `vault.balance` before the call plus `amount` exceeds u64::MAX, `deposit` must fail and leave `vault.balance` (and `authority`/`bump`) unchanged, since a wrapping credit would silently shrink the recorded balance and permanently strand the deposited lamports in the PDA.
Deposits.title: deposit_reverts_on_balance_overflow

Deposits.description: `deposit` never modifies `vault.authority` or `vault.bump`, so an arbitrary depositor cannot re-point a vault's ownership or its PDA derivation (and thereby gain withdrawal rights) by depositing into someone else's vault.
Deposits.title: deposit_preserves_vault_authority_and_bump

Deposits.description: `deposit` must fail unless the account passed as `depositor` is a signer; if the signer check were missing or weakened to an AccountInfo, anyone could debit a third party's lamports into a vault they do not control.
Deposits.title: deposit_requires_depositor_signature

Deposits.description: `deposit` must fail unless the `vault` account's key equals the canonical PDA of seeds ["vault", vault.authority] for this program — note the handler validates with the *stored* `vault.bump` rather than re-deriving the canonical bump, so a vault whose stored bump is non-canonical, or an attacker-supplied look-alike account, must not be creditable.
Deposits.title: deposit_requires_canonical_vault_pda

Deposits.description: The only lamport movement `deposit` performs is a System Program CPI transferring exactly `amount` lamports from the `depositor` account to the very same `vault` account whose recorded `balance` is credited — no raw lamport mutation of `vault` or `depositor`, and no third-party source or destination — otherwise a caller could fund one vault while crediting another, or credit a vault while lamports land elsewhere.
Deposits.title: deposit_transfer_matches_credited_account_and_amount

Deposits.description: If the System Program transfer CPI returns an error (e.g. the depositor is short of lamports), `deposit` must abort with `vault.balance` unchanged rather than swallowing the `Result` and crediting the balance, since a credit without an incoming transfer makes the recorded balance exceed the lamports held and lets the vault be over-withdrawn.
Deposits.title: deposit_credit_only_after_successful_transfer

Deposits.description: With the System Program transfer modeled as an exact lamport move, the vault PDA's lamports minus its recorded `balance` is never decreased by `deposit` (the rent/surplus cushion is never consumed and the vault never becomes under-collateralized); this invariant ranges over every lamport-moving handler of the program, `deposit` and `withdraw` alike.
Deposits.title: deposit_preserves_vault_lamport_solvency

Deposits.description: A signer that is not `vault.authority` can successfully complete `deposit` on an existing, canonically-derived vault when `amount` neither overflows the recorded balance nor exceeds the depositor's lamports, so the documented "anyone may deposit into any vault" behavior is not made dead by an over-strict authority or PDA guard.
Deposits.title: deposit_reachable_for_non_authority_depositor
